title: Maxwell Engineering Solutions IPO Details
intro:
Maxwell Engineering Solutions IPO is a book build issue of ₹57.64 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 36.48 lakh shares of ₹57.64 crore.

Maxwell Engineering Solutions IPO opens for subscription on Oct 30, 2026 and closes on Nov 3, 2026. The allotment for the Maxwell Engineering Solutions IPO is expected to be finalized on Nov 4, 2026. Maxwell Engineering Solutions IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Nov 6, 2026.

Maxwell Engineering Solutions IPO is set issue price band at ₹150 to ₹158 per share. The lot size for an application is 800 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,52,800 (1,600 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (2,400 shares), amounting to ₹3,79,200.

JDA Capital Services Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Jda Capital Services Ltd.

Refer to Maxwell Engineering Solutions IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in September 2022, Maxwell Engineering Solutions Limited is a precision engineering company engaged in the manufacturing, trading and servicing of critical components for underwater pelletizing systems. The Company manufactures a range of components for underwater pelletizing systems, including pelletizing die plates, pelletizing blades and knives, blade holders, cutter hubs, tapped driving bushes and other spare parts. Its products cater to polymer compounding, masterbatches, engineering plastics, cable compounds, specialty polymers and plastics recycling industries. The Company also undertakes customised manufacturing based on customer specifications and offers white-label manufacturing, enabling customers to market products under their own brands. Its business operates through three segments: manufacturing, services and trading.

The Company commenced operations at its company-owned manufacturing facility at Waghodia GIDC, Vadodara, Gujarat, in July 2025 and has progressively transitioned manufacturing activities from its earlier leased facility in Makarpura, Vadodara. Its manufacturing infrastructure includes precision machining and testing equipment such as VMC, CNC, milling, EDM, wire-cut, lathe and surface-grinding machines. Certain specialised processes, including heat treatment, hardening and coating, are outsourced to job workers. The Company also provides refurbishment and repair services for used die plates, intermediary support for the marketing and supply of CJTEK components, and management consulting services for developing customer relationships.

The Company serves customers across India and international markets, including the USA, Germany, the Netherlands, Israel, Saudi Arabia, Japan, Australia, Italy and other countries. It holds ISO 9001:2015 certification for manufacturing and supplying pelletizing system components and received ZED Bronze Certification under the MSME Sustainable Certification Scheme in November 2025. Its operations are supported by an experienced promoter and management team, technical personnel and dedicated sales and marketing capabilities.

As of September 30, 2026, the Company had 71 full-time employees, excluding Directors, across production and operations, quality and testing, design, sales and marketing, finance, administration and other functions.

Maxwell Engineering Solutions IPO is a book build issue of ₹57.64 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 36.48 lakh shares of ₹57.64 crore.

Maxwell Engineering Solutions IPO opens for subscription on Oct 30, 2026 and closes on Nov 3, 2026. The allotment for the Maxwell Engineering Solutions IPO is expected to be finalized on Nov 4, 2026. The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (2,400 shares), amounting to ₹3,79,200.

JDA Capital Services Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Jda Capital Services Ltd.

Refer to Maxwell Engineering Solutions IPO RHP for detailed Information.

Maxwell Engineering Solutions IPO comprises a total issue size of 36,48,000 shares. The net offer to the public is 34,25,600 shares, after excluding 2,22,400 shares allotted on a firm basis. Of the Net offer 17,07,200 (49.84%) are allocated to QIB , 5,18,400 (15.13%) allocated to NII 12,00,000 (35.03%) allocated to RII .

Investors can bid for a minimum of 1,600 shares and in multiples of 800 shares thereof.

Incorporated in September 2022, Maxwell Engineering Solutions Limited is a precision engineering company engaged in the manufacturing, trading and servicing of critical components for underwater pelletizing systems. The Company manufactures a range of components for underwater pelletizing systems, including pelletizing die plates, pelletizing blades and knives, blade holders, cutter hubs, tapped driving bushes and other spare parts. Its products cater to polymer compounding, masterbatches, engineering plastics, cable compounds, specialty polymers and plastics recycling industries. The Company also undertakes customised manufacturing based on customer specifications and offers white-label manufacturing, enabling customers to market products under their own brands. Its business operates through three segments: manufacturing, services and trading.

The Company commenced operations at its company-owned manufacturing facility at Waghodia GIDC, Vadodara, Gujarat, in July 2025 and has progressively transitioned manufacturing activities from its earlier leased facility in Makarpura, Vadodara. Its manufacturing infrastructure includes precision machining and testing equipment such as VMC, CNC, milling, EDM, wire-cut, lathe and surface-grinding machines. Certain specialised processes, including heat treatment, hardening and coating, are outsourced to job workers. The Company also provides refurbishment and repair services for used die plates, intermediary support for the marketing and supply of CJTEK components, and management consulting services for developing customer relationships.

The Company serves customers across India and international markets, including the USA, Germany, the Netherlands, Israel, Saudi Arabia, Japan, Australia, Italy and other countries. It holds ISO 9001:2015 certification for manufacturing and supplying pelletizing system components and received ZED Bronze Certification under the MSME Sustainable Certification Scheme in November 2025. Its operations are supported by an experienced promoter and management team, technical personnel and dedicated sales and marketing capabilities.

As of September 30, 2026, the Company had 71 full-time employees, excluding Directors, across production and operations, quality and testing, design, sales and marketing, finance, administration and other functions.

Maxwell Engineering Solutions Ltd.'s revenue increased by 36% and profit after tax (PAT) rose by 29% between the financial year ending with March 31, 2026 and March 31, 2025.

faqs.question: How to apply in Maxwell Engineering Solutions IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the Maxwell Engineering Solutions IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for Maxwell Engineering Solutions IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the Maxwell Engineering Solutions IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .
